name: Zscore
description: This keyword has 2 inputs, one is to select the series, other is to select the period which is the no. of previous values to consider or the sample
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword will return the Zscore of the selected series of the particular instrument.

Zscore is generally used under the position keyword

This keyword has 2 inputs, one is to select the series, other is to select the period which is the no. of previous values to consider or the sample

![Example](./images/img-1632227109.png)

The above condition will return the Zscore of the NIFTY 50 close series, considering the sample data of the past 20 candles

Zscore keyword used in Tradetron is part of SCIPY library - https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/generated/scipy.stats.zscore.html
